integrity: The derivation is analytic for all cycle lengths at least three; finite enumerations and numerical Fourier tests are supplementary and not completeness certificates for prior literature.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns vertex-uniform covariance in the canonical coordinate embedding, not interior-volume covariance; older transfer-matrix correlation/structure-factor formulas might imply pieces. A plausible related cyclic graph-polytope paper could only be read at abstract level, so historical priority remains provisional.
title: The complete vertex-covariance spectrum of cycle stable-set polytopes
